Source: Abuse Filter License: GPL-2.0-or-later Check to see if an AbuseFilter matches a set of variables, an edit, or a logged AbuseFilter event. vars, rcid of logid word vereis, maar slegs een mag gebruik word. Specific parameters: Other general parameters are available. filter The full filter text to check for a match. This parameter is required. vars JSON encoded array of variables to test against. rcid Recent change ID to check against. Type: integer logid Abuse filter log ID to check against. Type: integer Example: Test if recent change ID 15 matches a simple filter api.php?action=abusefiltercheckmatch&filter=!("autoconfirmed"%20in%20user_groups)&rcid=15 [open in sandbox] Ontsluit van " https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spesiaal:ApiHelp "
